cat > REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# CSV export review

## Question and scope

Does the default CLI preserve Unicode, field contents and input column order
when exporting one CSV record? The historical implementation (`2e91c9c`) defaults
to `baseline`, which strips non-ASCII characters and does not escape CSV fields.
The prepared change already selected `full`; it fixed Unicode, comma, quote and
LF cases. Review additionally found that bare CR needed quoting. The finished
change handles CR too, without sorting or otherwise reordering input values.

This is a deterministic functional comparison of executable configurations, not
an instruction-following/model-policy experiment. There is no historical policy
instruction in this repository to evaluate. The current request's column-order
requirement is tested independently from escaping and Unicode preservation.
No model prompts, provider calls, usage comparisons or empty-policy control
apply; `baseline` is an executable component control, not an empty policy.

## Reviewed observations

`test/csv-results.json` contains actual stdout/stderr, exit status, individual
ratings/reasons, complete source snapshots and SHA-256 hashes. All executions
completed with status 0; none were infrastructure failures. Failures below are
incorrect CSV contents, not command failures or response-format violations.

| Case | Historical default / baseline | Prepared default | Current default / full | Without Unicode | Without escaping |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unicode | fail: characters lost | pass | pass | fail: characters lost | pass |
| Comma and quotes | fail: invalid fields | pass | pass | pass | fail: invalid fields |
| Column order and scalar conversion | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| LF in field | fail: extra record | pass | pass | pass | fail: extra record |
| CR in field | fail: extra record | fail: extra record | pass | pass | fail: extra record |
| Significant whitespace / empty last field | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| Empty row | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |

The two original selection cases (Unicode and escaping) are reused diagnostics,
not independent validation. The other five are synthetic regression coverage,
not representative workload frequencies or proof of universal CSV correctness.
The ablations remove Unicode retention or all escaping, respectively. Both
retain field traversal order and String conversion. Ablation failures diagnose
components; improvement is established separately against historical and
prepared defaults. The prepared default already fixes three historical failures;
the final CR fix improves only the CR case relative to that intermediate state.

`test/csv-before-cr-results.json` preserves the first run, where the prepared
exporter still failed CR (including current-default/full). Replay faithfully
reproduces that failure and exits nonzero. A local edit initially could not run
because Python was unavailable; that shell failure was not an exporter failure.
The edit was applied with Node instead. No responses were resampled.

## Reproduction and grading

Prerequisites: Node.js (tested v22.23.4), Git with commit `2e91c9c`, and a writable
temporary directory. No dependencies, network, sandbox exceptions or secrets.
Run from the repository root:

```sh
node test/csv-review.mjs --replay test/csv-results.json
node test/csv-review.mjs --replay test/csv-before-cr-results.json # expected failure
node test/csv-review.mjs --run .local/csv-fresh.json
```

Fresh runs read the production `app.mjs` and historical Git source, derive the
prepared revision by changing only the default, freeze all source snapshots,
cases and conditions before execution, and interleave conditions per case.
Saved scores can be replayed without executing the exporter. Replay checks source
hashes and the grader hash; it does not silently replace captured stdout.

The grader parses exactly one CSV record and compares every field to the input
in order after String conversion. Equivalent quoting and optional LF/CRLF record
terminators are accepted. Extra records, malformed quotes, missing fields,
character loss and reordered fields fail. Empty arrays intentionally produce an
empty record, matching the existing CLI contract. Stdout is never trimmed.
Grader self-tests run before executions and include known correct, incorrect,
equivalently quoted, multiline, CR and stdout-trimming constructions.

No manual score assignment is required. Reviewers can compare the JSON's actual
stdout with its case input and rating reason. Runtime errors are separate from
functional failures; spawn errors/timeouts are infrastructure outcomes. Review
new generated evidence before replacing tracked results. Local private runtime
metadata and old development scripts are neither required nor staged.
EOF

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+
+// Parse exactly one CSV record. Quoted and unquoted equivalent fields are valid.
+export function grade(stdout, input) {
+  try {
+    const fields = [];
+    let i = 0;
+    while (true) {
+      let field = '';
+      if (stdout[i] === '"') {
+        i++;
+        let closed = false;
+        while (i < stdout.length) {
+          if (stdout[i] !== '"') field += stdout[i++];
+          else if (stdout[i + 1] === '"') { field += '"'; i += 2; }
+          else { i++; closed = true; break; }
+        }
+        if (!closed) throw Error('unclosed quoted field');
+      } else {
+        while (i < stdout.length && !',\r\n'.includes(stdout[i])) {
+          if (stdout[i] === '"') throw Error('quote in unquoted field');
+          field += stdout[i++];
+        }
+      }
+      fields.push(field);
+      if (stdout[i] === ',') { i++; continue; }
+      const rest = stdout.slice(i);
+      if (!['', '\n', '\r\n'].includes(rest)) throw Error('extra record or invalid delimiter');
+      break;
+    }
+    // An empty input array is exported as an empty record by this CLI.
+    assert.deepEqual(fields, input.length ? input.map(String) : ['']);
+    return {pass: true, reason: 'one record; field values and order preserved'};
+  } catch (error) {
+    return {pass: false, reason: error.message};
+  }
+}
+
+export function testGrader() {
+  for (const [stdout, input, pass] of [
+    ['Ada,Lin\n', ['Ada', 'Lin'], true],
+    ['"Ada","Lin"\r\n', ['Ada', 'Lin'], true],
+    ['Lin,Ada\n', ['Ada', 'Lin'], false],
+    ['"a\nb","say ""hi"""\n', ['a\nb', 'say "hi"'], true],
+    ['a,b\n', ['a,b'], false],
+    ['Zo,\n', ['Zoë', '東京'], false],
+    ['"unterminated\n', ['unterminated'], false],
+    ['a\nb\n', ['a', 'b'], false],
+    [' a \n', [' a '], true],
+    // Trimming stdout must not erase significant field data.
+    [' a \n'.trim(), [' a '], false],
+    ['"a\rb"\n', ['a\rb'], true],
+    ['a\rb\n', ['a\rb'], false],
+  ]) assert.equal(grade(stdout, input).pass, pass, JSON.stringify(stdout));
+}

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import os from 'node:os';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {spawnSync, execFileSync} from 'node:child_process';
+import {grade, testGrader} from './csv-grader.mjs';
+
+const hash = text => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');
+testGrader();
+const [mode, file] = process.argv.slice(2);
+if (!file || !['--run', '--replay'].includes(mode)) {
+  throw Error('Usage: node test/csv-review.mjs --run|--replay FILE');
+}
+let record;
+if (mode === '--run') {
+  const current = fs.readFileSync('app.mjs', 'utf8');
+  const historical = execFileSync('git', ['show', '2e91c9c:app.mjs'], {encoding: 'utf8'});
+  const prepared = historical.replace("|| 'baseline'", "|| 'full'");
+  assert.notEqual(prepared, historical);
+  const sources = {historical, prepared, current};
+  const casesText = fs.readFileSync('test/csv-cases.json', 'utf8');
+  // Freeze all sources, inputs, configurations and grader before any CLI run.
+  record = {
+    runtime: process.version,
+    sources,
+    sourceHashes: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(sources).map(([k, v]) => [k, hash(v)])),
+    graderSha256: hash(fs.readFileSync('test/csv-grader.mjs')),
+    casesSha256: hash(casesText),
+    cases: JSON.parse(casesText),
+    conditions: [
+      {id: 'historical-default', source: 'historical', args: []},
+      {id: 'prepared-default', source: 'prepared', args: []},
+      {id: 'current-default', source: 'current', args: []},
+      {id: 'baseline', source: 'current', args: ['baseline']},
+      {id: 'full', source: 'current', args: ['full']},
+      {id: 'without-unicode', source: 'current', args: ['without-unicode']},
+      {id: 'without-escaping', source: 'current', args: ['without-escaping']},
+    ],
+    results: [],
+  };
+  const temp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'csv-review-'));
+  try {
+    for (const [name, source] of Object.entries(sources)) {
+      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(temp, `${name}.mjs`), source);
+    }
+    // Interleave configurations on identical inputs; no models or sampling.
+    for (const task of record.cases) for (const condition of record.conditions) {
+      const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [path.join(temp, `${condition.source}.mjs`),
+        JSON.stringify(task.input), ...condition.args], {encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 5000});
+      const observation = {
+        case: task.id, condition: condition.id, stdout: result.stdout ?? '',
+        stderr: result.stderr ?? '', status: result.status, signal: result.signal,
+        infrastructureError: result.error?.message ?? null,
+      };
+      record.results.push({...observation, rating: rate(observation, task)});
+    }
+    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), {recursive: true});
+    fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(record, null, 2) + '\n');
+  } finally { fs.rmSync(temp, {recursive: true, force: true}); }
+} else {
+  record = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
+  for (const [key, source] of Object.entries(record.sources)) {
+    assert.equal(hash(source), record.sourceHashes[key]);
+  }
+  assert.equal(hash(fs.readFileSync('test/csv-grader.mjs')), record.graderSha256);
+  for (const result of record.results) {
+    assert.deepEqual(rate(result, record.cases.find(task => task.id === result.case)), result.rating);
+  }
+}
+for (const task of record.cases) {
+  console.log(task.id + ': ' + record.results.filter(r => r.case === task.id)
+    .map(r => `${r.condition}=${r.rating.type}`).join(', '));
+}
+// Baseline/ablation failures are observations, not test-suite failures.
+assert(record.results.filter(r => ['current-default', 'full'].includes(r.condition))
+  .every(r => r.rating.type === 'pass'), 'current exporter regression');
+
+function rate(result, task) {
+  if (result.infrastructureError) return {type: 'infrastructure', reason: result.infrastructureError};
+  if (result.status !== 0) return {type: 'execution-failure', reason: result.stderr};
+  const verdict = grade(result.stdout, task.input);
+  return {type: verdict.pass ? 'pass' : 'functional-failure', reason: verdict.reason};
+}
